newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal eases, deposits mainly steady.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal eases, deposits mainly steady.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal eased a little on the dollar this week while riyal interbank deposit rates were mainly steady in very quiet trade, dealers said.

"The market is very quiet because of (the Moslem fasting month of) Ramadan. Liquidity appears to be high in the market," one Riyadh-based dealer said. The spot riyal eased to 3.7502/04 to the dollar from 3.7501/03 to the dollar last week.

One-month interbank deposit rates lost 1/16 point to 5-9/16, 7/16 percent. Three months were unchanged at 5-11/16, 9/16 percent, six months were at 5-3/4, 5/8 percent and one-year deposits were put at six, 5-7/8 percent.
